productSpec: Create a short project introduction and a delivery guide that ordinary users can understand. Execution uses isolated Git worktrees; human reading experience remains a user decision.
technicalSpec: Only write notes/. Upstream notes/intro.txt is read-only for task 02. Do not modify other files, add dependencies or use network access. Return relative deliverable paths and verification evidence.

tasks.title: 01 · Project introduction
tasks.description: Create notes/intro.txt with two lines: Sonail Demo; Task isolation, independent review, manager oversight. Only write notes/intro.txt. Do not install dependencies or access the network.

criteria.text: notes/intro.txt contains exactly the requested two lines.
The user finds the introduction understandable.

tasks.title: 02 · Delivery guide
tasks.description: Read upstream notes/intro.txt without changing it. Create notes/delivery.md naming the source file and quoting both lines exactly, followed by a concise explanation. Only write notes/delivery.md. No network or dependency installation.

criteria.text: notes/delivery.md names notes/intro.txt and quotes its actual two lines accurately; upstream is unchanged.
The user can understand the delivery guide without technical expertise.
